notes: Both occurrences of יִשְׂבַּע are rendered by a light verb plus complement (*plenty*, *enough*), headed on the complement under rule 44; לָחֶם and רִישׁ are bare objects, so the *of* and the *after* are the predicates' valency words rather than rule 19 relations.
*persons* is the generic the ASV supplies to complete רֵקִים, headed on *vain* (rule 31).
